title: Fitbit Daily Step Goal Adherence
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fitbit:activity
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(steps) as steps by _time
| eval goal=10000, met_goal=if(steps>=goal,1,0)
| timechart span=1w sum(met_goal) as days_goal_met
description: Counts how many days each week you hit your daily step goal, turning a single day's number into a habit-strength signal.
value: Consistency beats intensity for everyday health; counting goal-met days rewards the habit rather than a one-off big walk.
implementation: Ingest Fitbit daily activity summaries; schedule weekly and review the count of goal-met days as your habit score.
visualization: Column chart of goal-met days per week out of seven.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many days you reached your step goal, so you can see if walking is becoming a steady habit.
